title: Fix Breach Kind Tree Ids And Uris
description: Fix statute IDs to use tree structure with # separators and slash-separated paths instead of flat colon-separated format. Change path from colon-separated to slash-separated, ID format to titleized with # separators, and ensure policy tree renders breachs as nested tree not flat list.
summary: Changed statute constants from colon-separated to slash-separated paths. Added TitleizeSlug, StatutePathToIdValue, StatuteIdValueToPath helpers. Updated GetID to produce hash-separated titleized format. Refactored policy tree to render nested tree with redundant root stripping. Updated all tests and added comprehensive new test functions. Fixed pre-existing test bugs.
